michelle_sales: ACME follow-up: they want final answers on SAML attributes, SCIM lifecycle, RBAC mapping semantics, domain verification, and whether we can do a 3-month Dedicated POC with monthly billing. Can we consolidate?

devon_se: I'll handle the SAML/SCIM spec. Quick notes: we accept SAML with NameID as email (format), attributes supported: email, givenName, familyName, groups. We enforce AudienceRestriction and ACS must match tenant config. We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.

claire_security: Security constraints from legal: signed assertions with SHA256, IdP cert rotation window (we support rotating certs by uploading new metadata before expiry), and prefer SLO (SingleLogout) support but it's optional for POC. Also confirm we honor ForceAuthn=false.

michelle_sales: Good. They also asked whether we do JIT create on SAML login versus requiring SCIM for reliable deprovisioning.

devon_se: JIT is available for Hosted and makes onboarding simple. But to ensure timely deprovisioning and canonical group state, recommend SCIM for Dedicated. For POC, recommend enabling both: SCIM for group sync + JIT for instant access.

rachel_pricing: On Dedicated POC pricing: standard minimum is monthly commit, but for enterprise POCs we can do a 3-month short-term contract with prorated discounts. I'll draft two options: (A) monthly commitment tier (standard) and (B) 3-month POC with temporary burst capacity and agreed SLAs. Need their expected concurrency and tokens/day to size.

sean_sre: From infra: SCIM performance for 50k users: initial bulk import via our CSV or SCIM bulk endpoints recommended. Delta syncs with pagination every 10 minutes recommended. Hosted default SCIM rate-limits: 10/min; Dedicated can be configured to 100+/min depending on capacity. Also we support incremental GET /Users?filter=meta.lastModified gt \"2025-01-01T00:00:00Z\" style queries.

michelle_sales: They specifically asked about group->role precedence. If a user is in multiple groups mapped to different roles, which role wins?

devon_se: We apply union of permissions (superset). Roles aren't exclusive by default. You can configure role precedence policy during tenant setup (e.g., highest privilege wins, or first-match). We'll document both approaches.

claire_security: Domain controls: we support (1) domain allowlist (verified via DNS TXT `redwood-verification=<token>`), (2) MX verification option if they prefer, and (3) org-admin enforced invites only. Also support blocking personal email domains.

michelle_sales: They want to see the SCIM sample requests & SAML attributes sample. Can someone paste minimal examples?

devon_se: Pasting SCIM PATCH example for group membership (minimal):
```json
PATCH /scim/Groups/{id}
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "add", "path": "members", "value": [{"value": "user-123", "display": "jane@acme.com"}]}
  ]
}
```

sean_sre: And SAML attribute example (assertion body excerpt):
```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email"><saml:AttributeValue>jane@acme.com</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="groups"><saml:AttributeValue>eng</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

rachel_pricing: Action item for pricing: michelle, please ask ACME for expected peak concurrent requests and monthly token volume so I can produce estimates for Hosted vs Dedicated POC.

michelle_sales: Will do. Also legal asked about EU-only data residency. Can we host Dedicated in eu-west-1 with BYOK?

claire_security: Yes. Dedicated can be provisioned in eu-west-1 with KMS BYOK and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. For Hosted, we have regional deployments but need to confirm isolation guarantees; I'll validate with infra.

ops_bot: ops-bot: created ticket PRESALES-4321 (ACME identity POC) with checklist: collect IdP metadata, sample assertion, group list, SCIM owner contact.

sean_sre: Minor enterprise blocker to call out: ACME requires SAML assertions to include a custom attribute `employeeType`. We can accept arbitrary attributes and map them but they'll need to add it to their IdP release policy.

michelle_sales: Perfect. Plan: I'll request IdP metadata, sample assertion, their group mapping sheet, concurrency & token estimates, and whether they require EU-only. We'll reconvene tomorrow to finalize proposal. Thanks all :raised_hands:
